description: This Java source file defines the 'CommunicationEventServices' class, which provides services for handling communication events such as sending emails, handling FTP file transfers, processing incoming emails, and managing communication event statuses within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for creating, updating, and processing communication events, as well as services specific to email and FTP interactions, tied into the larger OFBiz entity and service infrastructure.

classes.name: CommunicationEventServices
classes.description: This class provides a suite of static methods for managing communication events within the OFBiz framework, including sending emails, handling FTP transfers, processing incoming emails, creating communication events from triggers, updating statuses, and validating communications.

methods.name: sendCommEventAsEmail
methods.description: Sends a communication event as an email, handling multipart content and contact mechanisms, and updates the event status accordingly.

methods.name: sendCommEventAsFtp
methods.description: Transfers communication event content via FTP protocol, managing related content and nested events.

methods.name: sendEmailToContactList
methods.description: Sends emails to all contacts in a contact list, managing statuses and delivery attempts, and optionally recording success or failures.

methods.name: setCommEventComplete
methods.description: Marks a communication event as completed, recording end date/time and updating status.

methods.name: createCommEventFromFtpTransfer
methods.description: Creates a communication event in response to an FTP file transfer, associating relevant content and initializing event status.

methods.name: createCommEventFromEmail
methods.description: Creates a communication event object upon sending an email, capturing key email details for tracking.

methods.name: updateCommEventAfterEmail
methods.description: Updates communication event with email subject, message ID, and status after an email is sent, also handling attachments.

methods.name: storeIncomingEmail
methods.description: Main service for processing incoming email messages, extracting header/content info, associating with parties, and creating communication events.
